analysis.reasoning: The company reported record-breaking revenue and strong growth in Services and iPhone. Sentiment is highly positive, driven by the launch of Apple Intelligence (innovation momentum). Management shows high confidence in product ecosystems but remains cautious/conservative in forward guidance (low-to-mid single digit growth). Evasiveness was noted when Tim Cook declined to discuss tariffs and DOJ litigation, and Luca Maestri declined to provide specific color on China demand or potential revenue risks. Quantitative specificity is very high with numerous segment-specific figures provided.
